scope: Curated static key/attestation investigation. Source records remain local. No iPhone verifier or Windows-origin enrollment tested.

observations.confidence: high for the selected static boundary
observations.conclusion: Enrollment adapter forwards its request type into a conversion helper. The helper maps external types 5 and 6 to internal values 5 and 6.
limits: Conversion alone does not prove every subsequent dispatch route.

observations.confidence: high for the selected static boundary
observations.conclusion: SDAuthenticationAKSPairingSession type field is linked through source Objective-C metadata and chained-fixup pointer identities to the offset variable read by pairing creation. The creation call requests attestation for internal type 5 (and 6), using a type<21 test and mask 0x1800e0. The called constructor selects localAttestedLTK when attestation is requested; a missing local key takes its error path, with no ordinary-key fallback in that constructor.
limits: The runtime-initialized field displacement is not read from zero-fill file offset 0.
No fresh runtime reachability observation or proof that all current enrollment routes use this class.

observations.confidence: high for the selected static boundary
observations.conclusion: Attested generation reads DCRT through MAECopyDCRTMacOSWithError, adds its bytes as AKS parameter 0x15 and value 4 as parameter 0x14, serializes parameters and calls aks_create_signing_key_with_params. Ordinary generation has a separate aks_create_signing_key branch. Missing DCRT takes an error path in the selected helper.
limits: Parameter names and certificate contents are not reconstructed.
No activation request or key-generation API executed.

observations.confidence: high for the selected static boundary
observations.conclusion: The optional generation completion path invokes a helper calling MAEIssueDCRTMacOSWithCallback. The completion block reports activation errors and only invokes its generation block on success.
limits: The callback path is conditional; not every generation requests a fresh DCRT.

observations.confidence: high for the selected static boundary
observations.conclusion: Selected remote-key storage/signing code chooses a local attested key for its signing helper; separate production helpers call aks_remote_peer_setup. The peer-setup API wrapper selects operation 0x2e and reaches IOConnectCallMethod through an outlined helper.
limits: These are Mac-side boundaries. The driver/Secure Enclave certificate validation policy and the iPhone implementation remain unrecovered.
Whole current enrollment reachability and certificate chain validation are not established.

observations.confidence: high for the selected static boundary
observations.conclusion: Apple-hosted BuildManifest identifies iPhone17,1, iOS 27.0 build 24A437. AppOS was acquired separately and matches its manifest SHA-384; it is not the requested sharingd executable. Daemon extraction stopped without obtaining sharingd.
limits: Public metadata/component access does not establish iPhone attestation policy.
File search stalled at AppOS mounting; broader filesystem acquisition also needs additional disk headroom.

observations.confidence: unknown for peer acceptance; stronger evidence against a straightforward software-only port
observations.conclusion: The selected native enrollment path uses Apple activation DCRT and attested AKS signing-key material. Generating an ordinary Windows software key does not reproduce that path. Evidence does not yet establish whether the stock iPhone allows a compatible alternative.
limits: No fresh Windows enrollment, complete peer transcript, iPhone verifier or exhaustive fallback policy.
Current evidence supports an incompatibility hypothesis for ordinary software keys, not a universal impossibility proof.

observations.confidence: high for artifact identity and text equality; metadata is a search seed
observations.conclusion: Exact-build AppleSEPKeyStore was recovered from the firmware kernel. Original kernel carrier matches manifest SHA-384; independently decompressed bytes match the analyzed kernel; all extracted driver text bytes match the source fileset. C++ metadata locates AppleKeyStoreUserClient, but its certificate verification policy is not recovered.
limits: Unnamed vtable entries and local remote-session entitlement string references do not establish remote host acceptance.
One bounded method excerpt is saved without assigning it an unverified protocol role.

observations.confidence: high for manifest digest and carrier encryption metadata; unknown for internal policy
observations.conclusion: Exact-build SEP firmware carrier matches manifest SHA-384. Its sepi payload is reported encrypted by the format parser. Raw payload extraction does not recover its plaintext application layout or peer certificate policy.
limits: Wrapped carrier keybag fields are not plaintext AES keys.
Layout-parser failures on carrier and raw ciphertext are not evidence of peer rejection or Windows impossibility.
